definition: [ כִּתִּי ] adjective, of a people always plural כִּתִּים כִּתִּיִּים ; usually as name, of a people = Cypriotes (compare Phoenician proper name, of a location כת כתי , Citium ; on a connection with Kheta , –-t¹, –attê , חִתִּי , see WMM Asien u. Europa,345 ; — on Citium see Cesnola Gyprus 46 ff ); — אֶרֶץ כִּתִּים Isa 23:1 , כִּתִּיי֯ם v Isa 23:12 כִּתִּים (as son of Yawan) Gen 10:4 = 1Chr 1:7 וְצִים ׳ מִיַּד כ Num 24:24 ships from the side (direction) of Kittim ; more generally, of coast-lands of Mediterranean, אִיֵּי כִּתִּיִּים Jer 2:10 , אִיֵּי כִּתִּיִּם Ezek 27:6 even of Macedonian Greece, צִיִּים כִּתִּים Dan 11:30 (only here as adjective, compare Bev ) i.e. Grecian ships. כָּתִית see below כתת .

Europa,345; — on Citium see CesnolaGyprus 46 ff); — אֶרֶץ כִּתִּים Isa 23:1, כִּתִּיי֯ם vIsa 23:12 כִּתִּים (as son of Yawan) Gen 10:4 = 1Chr 1:7 וְצִים ׳מִיַּד כ Num 24:24 ships from the side (direction) of Kittim; more generally, of coast-lands of Mediterranean, אִיֵּי כִּתִּיִּים Jer 2:10, אִיֵּי כִּתִּיִּם Ezek 27:6 even of Macedonian Greece, צִיִּים כִּתִּים Dan 11:30 (only here as adjective, compare Bev) i.e. Grecian ships.
